comment: Read from src/MorphfastMini.cpp and MorphFastMini_manual_EN.md at commit d2a810c, the commit that carries version 2.2.2. The Ease in and Ease out parameters, indices 7 and 8, have no widget on the panel at all: they are reached only through the module menu, where src/MorphfastMini.cpp:446 to 453 attach their parameter quantities to two sliders. They therefore get no line and no tag, and are covered by menu lines instead. The easing is a single quadratic, at src/MorphfastMini.cpp:117 to 119, whose coefficients are one minus ease-in plus ease-out and ease-in minus ease-out, which is why equal settings cancel to the linear shape. The duration ceiling at src/MorphfastMini.cpp:138 is 64 minus the delay in pulses, so a long delay shortens the longest transition available. Everything the manual states about ranges, curve behaviour, the 10ms end-of-transition trigger and the same-step window matched the source.
